items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 239:1
items.html: The head of Atik is called the revealed head, or RDL"A, because the lower ones have no attainment whatsoever in it. (Item 222, and Etz Chaim, Gate 47, Chapter 6).
